questions.explanation: The trap is: 25% of 60 is just 25. Percent means per hundred instead: 25% is one quarter, and one quarter of 60 is 60 / 4 = 15.
Scene s1 shades the hundred-grid: percent means per hundred, so 25% is twenty-five cells out of one hundred, whatever the whole in a question turns out to be.

questions.answer: 25% = 25/100 = 1/4: divide the top and the bottom by 25.
questions.explanation: Scene s3 makes the turn: 25 out of 100 simplifies to one quarter, which is the fraction that does the work in 25% of 60.
questions.prompt: Write 25% as a fraction in its simplest form and explain the step.

questions.explanation: Scene s3 divides the whole into four equal parts: each part is 15, so one quarter of 60 - and 25% of 60 - is 15.

questions.explanation: Use the same per-hundred idea: 10% is 10 out of 100, which is one tenth, and one tenth of 60 is 60 / 10 = 6.
